decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt builds directly on the firm's core organic dairy and fermentation know-how and its close farmer partnerships, so management can read its results well and refine it, and as a flagship extension of an established range it is very likely kept.
Mild sliced cheese draws on the firm's in-house cheesemaking expertise, so it can be assimilated and improved easily, though a crowded sliced-cheese shelf adds some risk of a range cleanup.

Sliced butter cheese uses existing cheesemaking capabilities and slicing infrastructure and serves both household and foodservice customers, so it is kept, although overlap with the mild sliced cheese makes it slightly more exposed to consolidation.
